reason: Both conversations issue a clear stop-using and unplug warning once the burning smell is revealed, and both escalate to an engineer. Conversation 1 elicited both the smell and the visible sparking, took the model number (HVR 200-22), and correctly pointed to the motor brushes/bearings/winding, though its opening claim that it is 'generally not worth repairing' was premature and its middle turn wasted a question on filter seating. Conversation 2 never drew out the sparking, spent a turn on a brush bar question that does not apply to a Henry cylinder, and leaned toward disposal ('replacement is the safer option') without the model number or the brushes diagnosis. Conversation 1's more complete and accurate safety picture and its better-targeted direction give it a slight edge.
